proofs.statement: SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1) cannot be realized as a subgroup of G2 (the triality-fixed subgroup of Spin(8)) under any embedding.
proofs.method: Maximal torus theorem: for a closed subgroup H of a compact Lie group G, rank(H) <= rank(G). rank(SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1)) = 2+1+1 = 4. rank(G2) = 2. 4 > 2, so no embedding exists. Dimension-independent, fully general, formally decisive -- see compiler/backends/toe_closure_hypotheses.py::h4_g2_spin8_construction_check and FALS-H4-G2-TRIALITY-RANK-OBSTRUCTION for the full statement of standard Lie-theory facts used.
